item.title: Binance says it has reserved $6.34B+ in company funds, including $5B already held in impacted token assets, to deal with the fallout from the $6.3B hack (Rajveer Singh Pardesi/Reuters)
item.description:
Rajveer Singh Pardesi / Reuters:
Binance says it has reserved $6.34B+ in company funds, including $5B already held in impacted token assets, to deal with the fallout from the $6.3B hack  —  Binance said on Friday it has reserved more than $6.34 billion in company funds, including $5 billion already held in impacted token assets …

Original (direct link): https://www.reuters.com/legal/transactional/binance-sets-aside-over-634-billion-cover-losses-attack-2026-10-30/

item.title: FEC data: AI-oriented PACs spent nearly $80M on the 2026 US elections, mostly before the primaries; pro-regulatory PACs outspent Leading the Future's network (Ian Krietzberg/Puck)
item.description:
Ian Krietzberg / Puck:
FEC data: AI-oriented PACs spent nearly $80M on the 2026 US elections, mostly before the primaries; pro-regulatory PACs outspent Leading the Future's network  —  To almost everyone's surprise, pro-regulatory PACs have outspent pro-industry groups in the midterms as the A.I. accelerationists seemingly took their foot off the pedal.

Original (direct link): https://puck.news/ai/2026/10/pro-ai-pacs-are-retreating-from-the-midterms

item.title: CXMT reports Q3 revenue of ~$16.7B, up 613.2% YoY, and a net profit of ~$8.17B, swinging to profitability on the back of rising AI-driven memory chip prices (Reuters)
item.description:
Reuters:
CXMT reports Q3 revenue of ~$16.7B, up 613.2% YoY, and a net profit of ~$8.17B, swinging to profitability on the back of rising AI-driven memory chip prices  —  China's CXMT (688825.SS) said on Friday it swung to a net profit in the third quarter as surging AI-driven demand drove prices higher for its memory chips.

Original (direct link): https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/cxmt-turns-third-quarter-net-profit-544-billion-yuan-2026-10-30/

item.description:

item.title: Binance reveals that a follow-up investigation has found "additional points of breach" beyond a possibly compromised laptop and says this was a "complex attack" (@binance)
item.description:
@binance:
Binance reveals that a follow-up investigation has found “additional points of breach” beyond a possibly compromised laptop and says this was a “complex attack”  —  Investigation update: Our initial investigation suggested that the security incident may have involved a compromised laptop, however our subsequent investigation has uncovered additional points of breach. This was a complex attack, and we are doing all we can in coordination with law enforcement...

Original (direct link): https://x.com/binance/status/2116089661408108712

item.title: How a wave of startups are betting on AI to make formal software verification practical and essential, including &Truth, which launches with a $70M seed (Paresh Dave/Wired)
item.description:
Paresh Dave / Wired:
How a wave of startups are betting on AI to make formal software verification practical and essential, including &Truth, which launches with a $70M seed  —  A new startup called &Truth is joining the race to automate formal verification, a painstaking process that uses math to prove software works as intended.

item.title: TRM Labs attributes the Binance hack to North Korea-based TraderTraitor, which drained ~$6.36B from Binance wallets across 10 blockchains, mostly in ~20 minutes (Tom Westbrook/Reuters)
item.description:
Tom Westbrook / Reuters:
TRM Labs attributes the Binance hack to North Korea-based TraderTraitor, which drained ~$6.36B from Binance wallets across 10 blockchains, mostly in ~20 minutes  —  North Korean hackers were behind a $6.3 billion raid on cryptocurrency exchange Binance, according to US blockchain analysis firm TRM Labs.

Original (direct link): https://www.reuters.com/legal/government/blockchain-analysis-firm-trm-says-north-korea-behind-binance-crypto-theft-2026-10-30/

item.title: Binance pledges to cover all losses from a ~$6.3B hack, potentially the largest crypto theft ever, surpassing the $1.5B Bybit hack in February 2025 (South China Morning Post)
item.description:
South China Morning Post:
Binance pledges to cover all losses from a ~$6.3B hack, potentially the largest crypto theft ever, surpassing the $1.5B Bybit hack in February 2025  —  Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume, has pledged to cover all losses from a hack that it said drained around US$6.3 billion from its wallet.

Original (direct link): https://www.scmp.com/business/cryptocurrency/article/3372664/binance-pledges-cover-losses-after-us6-billion-crypto-hack

item.title: CrowdStrike: China-linked hackers used AI tool ARTEX with a DeepSeek LLM and another model to target 200+ organizations in 11 days, compromising at least nine (Kevin Collier/NBC News)
item.description:

CrowdStrike: China-linked hackers used AI tool ARTEX with a DeepSeek LLM and another model to target 200+ organizations in 11 days, compromising at least nine  —  Chinese state-linked hackers targeted more than 200 organizations in just 11 days, using AI to attack governments and businesses worldwide, according to CrowdStrike.

Original (direct link): https://www.nbcnews.com/tech/security/china-linked-hackers-used-ai-target-200-organizations-crowdstrike-says-rcna606343
